name: Marin and Photoshoot
justification: One clean reduction (only adjacent-zero gaps matter), tiny loop, unique numeric answer.
solution_sketch: The binding constraints are segments between consecutive 0s: any two 0s need >= two 1s between them. For each consecutive pair of 0s with g ones between, add max(0, 2-g). Length-2 windows with two 0s are the worst case, so this suffices.
